domain_id.description: Stable unique identity for this trust domain

trust_score.description: Current domain trust score (0.1 floor per C-4, emerges from survival history)

trust_score_updated.description: ISO timestamp of last trust score update

constitutional_floor.description: Minimum trust score — 0.1 per C-4, cannot be zero

challenge_history_score.description: Fraction of this domain's raised challenges that were upheld — C-9 input

challenges_raised.description: Total challenges raised by this domain

challenges_upheld.description: Challenges raised by this domain that were upheld (molecule survived)

challenges_rejected.description: Challenges raised by this domain that were rejected (challenge accepted, molecule failed)

molecules_contributed.description: Total molecules created by this domain

molecules_verified_strong.description: Molecules from this domain that have reached VERIFIED_STRONG

molecules_reinforced.description: Molecules from this domain that have reached REINFORCED

survived_challenge_count.description: Total survived_challenge facts in this domain's molecule lineage

endorsed_by_domains.description: domain_ids that have endorsed this domain — C-4 trust graph edges

damping_factor.description: This domain's kCvRank damping factor (0.4-0.8, default 0.6 per Constitution v1.0)

access_tier_granted.description: Maximum access tier this domain is authorised for

last_activity_date.description: ISO timestamp of last governance or contribution activity — inactivity triggers trust decay

inactivity_decay_due.description: ISO timestamp when trust decay activates if no activity recorded

constitution_version.description: Constitution version under which this domain was registered

founding_fact_id.description: fact_id of the domain_endorsed or molecule_created fact that instantiated this domain in the journal
